hero.title: Does GTA VI run on PC yet?
hero.lede: Every serious attempt to recompile, emulate or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC, scored on one scale from groundwork to a game you can play to the end.

race.sub: The efforts with public code, ranked by how close each is to running the game. Scores come from each project's public README, commits and issues. Self-reported claims are labelled. Private builds are listed below the race, without a rank.

tools.title: Toolkit
tools.sub: These won't run the game, but every port leans on them: archive explorers, texture codecs and format notes.
inbox.title: New candidates
inbox.sub: Every 3 hours the scout searches GitHub, GitLab, Hacker News, Bluesky, Mastodon, Lemmy and 4chan (/v/, /vg/) for new efforts. Repos with real code are listed here until they're reviewed. They are deliberately not linked, and copies of tracked projects are filtered out.
safety.title: There is no download
safety.body: No project on this page hosts the game, keys or an executable, and this site never links to any. Anything offering a ready-to-play GTA VI for PC this week is a scam.
method.title: How the progress bar works
method.sub: One scale for every project, in two parts. Getting in is a ladder to 50%: groundwork fills the first 10%, then each step needs the one before it, up to Playable. Playing well fills the rest: how far you can play, how right it looks, how fast it runs and how long it keeps running. 100% is the whole game, finished.
method.fine1: Partial steps, such as a menu that renders but is broken, count half. The four tracks only count once a build is Playable: you can't judge how well a game plays before you can play it.
method.tracksSub: Past Playable, the last 50 points come from four tracks side by side. Story and rendering follow the written steps below.
track.locked: These count once a build is Playable
method.fine2: Maintain a project and think it's mis-scored? Open an issue with a link to your evidence.

board.title: Board
board.sub: Talk about the efforts, share what you've tested, ask questions. No account needed.
board.rule1b: Posts with any link wait for review before they appear.
board.rule2: Never post game files, keys or "working exe" offers. They're scams.
board.rule3: Don't share personal info, yours or anyone else's.
board.rule4: Tips about real progress are welcome. We read the board when updating the tracker.
board.footer: Fan-made tracker. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games, Take-Two or Microsoft. Posts are anonymous and are the views of their authors. Page views are counted anonymously, with no cookies and no IP addresses stored.
